spec.assertion: it.skip + a positive assertion that the line is recorded in `unmodeled.skill1`. No StatKey or EffectDef expresses debuff immunity, and the v1 boss applies no ally debuffs, so the payload is both unmodelable and unobservable. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'silently dropped' model (no unmodeled record) and under any model that invents a stat buff to stand in for it.

Branching assertion: if the override omits the line, it must appear in `unmodeled.skill1`; if the override models it (as a passive, assuming the threshold is crossed immediately), the effect must be `casterAtkPct` targeting `allies`. Fails under the nearest-wrong `atkPct` encoding, which scales each ally's OWN ATK — the Attacker carry (118,027) would get a materially larger grant than caster-scaling off ade's Supporter ATK (98,367). Also fails under a silent drop.

it.skip + `unmodeled.skill2` record. The hitCount:420 trigger IS expressible, but the debuff-immunity payload is not — so the correct model is no block at all, not a block with an empty or substituted effect. Fails under a silent drop and under any invented-payload substitute.

spec.kitLine: Max HP 15.62% of user MaxHP, 120 atks
spec.assertion: Three assertions. (1) Cadence: each grant must be preceded by ≥120 of ADE's OWN shot events since the previous grant — fails under an `interval` model (grants decoupled from her shot log) and under `teamAmmo` (fires ~5× too often, so the per-grant shot delta collapses far below 120). (2) Value: emitted under stat `maxHpFlat` at 15.62% of ade's Max HP flat — fails under a model that emits the raw 15.62 percentage or uses `targetMaxHpPct` (which would scale each ally's own HP). (3) Target set: all 5 allies including self — fails under self-only or excludeSelf.

Emitted as `maxHpFlat` at 25.15% of ade's Max HP to all 5 allies, plus a strict inertness proof: stripping every Max HP effect from the override leaves EVERY unit's total byte-identical to 6 decimals. This pins the e3 rule (ally-granted Max HP never feeds a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct) and would fail loudly if a future engine change silently wired ally HP into a damage path.

spec.kitLine: ATK 10.15% of user ATK for 10 sec
spec.disposition: FAITHFUL — the ONLY damage-bearing line in the kit
spec.assertion: Five discriminating assertions. (1) Magnitude: `casterAtkPct` flat-resolved to 10.15% × ade's static ATK — fails if the raw percentage is asserted/emitted. (2) Scope: caster-scaled, not self-scaled — the `atkPct` counterfactual is required to produce a DIFFERENT carry total (ade is a Supporter, the carry an Attacker, so the two models cannot coincide). (3) Duration: 10s — the 5s counterfactual must strictly under-credit the team. (4) Trigger identity: the buffApply frame must be ≥ ade's burstCast frame and STRICTLY BEFORE the first fullBurstStart — fails under a `fullBurstEnter` re-key, which is the subtle trap here since ade is Burst II and casts every rotation, so the two models agree on COUNT and only timing separates them. (5) Target set: all allies — the self-only counterfactual must under-credit the team.

Every buffApply sourced from ade must carry a stat in {casterAtkPct, maxHpFlat}, and every damage event sourced from ade must be in the `normal` bucket. This is the anti-fudge guard: the kit grants no crit, core, element, charge, ammo, reload, fire-rate or burst-gen modifier and deals no skill/burst damage, so any such event is an invented mechanic. Fails under any override that pads this thin support kit to move the board.

Deleting the burst ATK line must strictly reduce team damage. Because it is the kit's only damage-bearing line, a null result here would mean the ENTIRE test file is asserting against buffs that never reach a shot — this assertion is what keeps the other six groups from being vacuous.

fixtures: controlComp('ade', true) — liter B1 / crown B2 / ade in the carry seat / fixed helm B3, boss Fire, focus ade. helm=true is REQUIRED, not optional: ade is Burst II, so without a B3 the chain never completes, zero Full Bursts occur, and every burst-cast-keyed assertion becomes vacuous. helm's own critRateNormalPct ally grant is a constant offset across all five arms (helm is unpatched everywhere), so it never contaminates an A/B delta. All counterfactuals are built with withPatchedOverride so the committed JSON is untouched — required under the parallel-run rule. 5 hoisted runComp calls + 1 inline run in the HP-inertness test = 6 total, under the ~20 budget.
gaps: skill1 'Perfect Maid: Gain debuff immunity to 1 debuff(s), stacking up to 1 time(s) continuously' — it.skip. No debuff-immunity primitive exists in EffectDef or StatKey, and the v1 scope-lock boss applies no ally debuffs, so the line is both unmodelable and unobservable. Belongs verbatim in unmodeled.skill1.

skill2 'Perfect Maid: Gain debuff immunity ... after 420 normal attack(s)' — it.skip. The hitCount:420 trigger is expressible but the payload is not; correct model is no block. Belongs verbatim in unmodeled.skill2.

skill1 'ATK 5.19% ... when own HP falls below 90%' — asserted branch-tolerantly rather than skipped. v1 models no HP pool (immortal allies, boss deals no damage), so the trigger is unreachable as written. Both 'unmodeled' and 'passive always-on' are defensible dispositions; the test pins whichever was chosen and enforces caster-scaling + ally targeting in the modeled branch. Flagged ⚑ — which disposition is correct is a modeling convention question, not derivable from the kit text alone.

⚑ AR cadence (pullsPerSec) is datamine-sourced and unreliable; the skill2 hitCount:120 assertion is therefore written as a RELATIVE shot-count delta (≥120 of ade's own shots between grants) rather than an absolute grant COUNT over the 180s fight, so it survives a cadence correction. An absolute-count assertion would have been a false pin on an unreliable field.
